notes: The episode audio is always supplied by the user as a local file.

Speaker identity is confirmed per beat through explicit evidence: preferably direct review of local clips; otherwise documented local audio analysis, a user label, a checksum-matched documented reference video, or silence. Local analysis is an optional operator-supplied aid, not a bundled transcription or diarization model. speaker=both requires documented simultaneous-speech evidence; uncertainty must stop for review and alternating voices must be split into single-speaker beats.
No speech, music, image, or video provider call occurs at runtime.
The smoke proof synthesizes a local tone only to exercise audio muxing without requiring episode content.
Cargo is required only when rebuilding PNG character poses from Toon Boom Harmony projects; normal video rendering uses the packaged PNG poses.
